verdict.rationale: Canny's own docs describe a hosted feedback site and portal that customers reach from your app and use to leave feedback directly, so the hosted intake portal is documented. Nothing in the pack mentions customers voting on ideas, which is a core half of the story. missing for 10: evidence of customer voting on ideas, detail on public/anonymous portal access and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can host a public feedback portal where customers submit and vote on ideas

citations.quote: In your application, add a link to your Canny feedback site. Put the link somewhere it's easy to find.
or directly from customers on your Portal
when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application
